answer: Video and audio submitted for verification are scored by a deepfake detector, and a score below the threshold blocks admission, so synthetic faces and cloned voices are caught at the gate. A farm must generate a thousand deepfakes that all beat the detector, and each new detector version re-scores the old fakes, while one honest agent shows its real face once. The tundra of the design is public, the beacon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the orchard of honest work is what finally pays.
